DIAGNOSIS READY: Torsion of the Right Testis

This condition explains the sudden onset of pain while playing football, the specific physical exam findings of an elevated testicle with a horizontal lie, pain on elevation (negative Prehn's sign), and the absent cremasteric reflex.
